device_visible_states.name: Disconnected
device_visible_states.description: No partner detected on the USB-C link; SBU + CC monitoring only.

device_visible_states.name: Training
device_visible_states.description: LT-LFPS link training + lane bonding in progress.

device_visible_states.name: Connected
device_visible_states.description: High-speed link up; router visible to the Connection Manager.

device_visible_states.name: Enumerated
device_visible_states.description: Connection Manager has read the router's config space and placed it in the spanning tree.

device_visible_states.name: Configured
device_visible_states.description: Paths/tunnels set up; adapters enabled; tunneled traffic flowing.

device_visible_states.name: Sleep/Low-power
device_visible_states.description: Link in a low-power state (e.g. USB4 sleep); resumes via SBU/LFPS.

fsm_hints.trigger: HPD assertion starts CAPABILITY_READ -> EDID_READ -> LINK_TRAINING -> ACTIVE. All control rides the AUX channel; the Main Link only carries video once trained.
fsm_hints.rule: Link training is strictly CR (TPS1) before EQ (TPS2/3/4); EQ success requires CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE on every active lane.
fsm_hints.abort: Repeated CR/EQ failure triggers fallback to a lower rate and/or fewer lanes; persistent failure leaves the link untrained.

anti_deadlock_rule: AUX transactions are half-duplex request/reply with retry on NACK/DEFER/timeout, so the bus cannot lock up; link training has a bounded loop-count before rate/lane fallback; MST time-slot allocation is bounded by the 64-slot table.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on the Source waits for HPD, then reads DPCD capability and EDID over AUX, trains the Main Link (CR then EQ with swing/pre-emphasis adjustment and rate/lane fallback), and enters ACTIVE to stream video; an IRQ_HPD prompts status re-read and possible re-training.

default_ready_state_recommendation.main_link_idle: Send blanking / idle symbols (BS framing) with no active video until trained and streaming.
default_ready_state_recommendation.aux_idle: AUX bus released (half-duplex), ready for the next request.
default_ready_state_recommendation.hpd: Sink keeps HPD asserted while connected; pulses IRQ_HPD on events.

connection_manager_rule: Exactly one Connection Manager (host-resident) owns path/tunnel allocation for the fabric; routers are passive forwarders programmed by it.
tunnel_setup_rule: Each tunnel = an end-to-end path = an ordered list of per-hop {adapter, hop ID} entries programmed into every router along the route by the Connection Manager.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: POWER_ON / RESET
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Source idle; waiting for the Sink to assert HPD (plug detect).

fsm_states_link_policy.name: CAPABILITY_READ
fsm_states_link_policy.description: On HPD, read the DPCD Receiver Capability (MAX_LINK_RATE, MAX_LANE_COUNT, FEC/DSC caps) over native AUX.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: EDID_READ
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Read the Sink EDID via I2C-over-AUX to learn supported timings.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: LINK_TRAINING
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Run Clock Recovery then Channel Equalization, setting TRAINING_PATTERN_SET and adjusting swing/pre-emphasis; fall back rate/lane-count on failure.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Stream video as micro-packets / Transfer Units; send MSA per frame; maintain audio / secondary data.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: IRQ_HPD
fsm_states_link_policy.description: On a short HPD pulse, re-read status (LANE*_STATUS, Device Service IRQ Vector); re-train or handle CP_IRQ as needed.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Write SET_POWER (D3) in DPCD; Main Link idle.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_START
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Set TRAINING_PATTERN_SET=TPS1; drive initial voltage swing / pre-emphasis on all active lanes.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_ADJUST
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Read ADJUST_REQUEST per lane; apply requested swing / pre-emphasis; wait the training interval.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_CHECK
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Read LANE*_STATUS; if all active lanes report CR_DONE proceed to EQ; else adjust or fall back.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_CHECK
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: Read LANE*_STATUS + LANE_ALIGN_STATUS_UPDATED; success requires CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE on all active lanes.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_DONE
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: Set TRAINING_PATTERN_SET=0 (stop training); link is trained, enter ACTIVE.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_FALLBACK
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: On failure, reduce link rate and/or lane count and restart Clock Recovery.

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_REQUEST
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: Source drives SYNC + START + command[4] + address[20] + length (+ write data).

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_REPLY
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: Sink drives reply command (ACK/NACK/DEFER or I2C_*) + read data.

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_RETRY
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: On NACK/DEFER or timeout, the Source retries the transaction.

configurations.name: 4-lane link
configurations.description: Four Main Link lanes (typical external connector).

timing_dependency_rule: The Main Link clock is embedded and recovered per lane during CR; multi-lane links are de-skewed/aligned during EQ (INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE). The Mvid/Nvid pair lets the Sink regenerate the pixel clock from the recovered link clock. AUX runs independently at ~1 Mbps Manchester-II.
